concept.title: Five things to know
concept.shortdesc: The five ideas behind uFTi, in two minutes.

section.title: A workspace is one family tree
section.p: You can have more than one. Each shows as a card on the screen. Make a new workspace for each tree.

section.title: People and families
section.p: Add a person for each relative. A family joins a couple. draws a tree from your families. Choose to see it.

section.title: Facts and sources
section.p: A fact is something you record, such as a birth with its date. A source is where you found it. It can be a certificate, a census page, or what someone told you. A small chip beside each heading on a person's page counts the sources. Choose the chip to add one. Then you will always know why you believe a fact.

section.title: Saving and copies
section.p: saves your work as you go. To keep a copy, choose on your workspace's card. Keep the file somewhere else too. Do it again after a big session.

section.title: Getting help
section.p: Look in this guide when you are stuck. Use its search box, and type the words you would say. Practise in a workspace you make for the purpose.
